neighbours.label: the piece right after 'bat': -ang of Batang, -on of baton, -he of bathe, -oid
fire: Ferries leave for Batangas every morning.
The town of Batang lies on the river.
Officers carried a baton at their side.
The conductor raised his baton for silence.
We bathe in the cold lake each morning.
The elephants bathe near the old bridge.
The batoid fish rests on the sand.
She visited Batangas with her aunt.
quiet: Ferries leave for Cebu every morning.
